claims.claim: **Chronic high-level use impairs vitamin B12 function, causing neurological dysfunction and rarely myelosuppression**; presentations often resemble **subacute combined degeneration of the spinal cord.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Assess every child with deliberate self-poisoning, and any child who has misused nitrous oxide and now has neurological symptoms.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Higher-risk pattern:** regular daily use, or more than 100 bulbs per session, is often reported in cases with neurological dysfunction.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Symptoms build up across days to weeks:** gait disturbance, muscle weakness, altered sensation; rarely depression, irritability or personality change.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Examination:** sensory deficits (dermatomal or patchy), **impaired proprioception and coordination — dorsal columns first**, sensory ataxia, reduced power and reflexes.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Acute toxicity is rare** — brief confusion, hallucinations or falls from temporary ataxia; ⚠️ **forceful inhalation can rarely cause pneumothorax.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **FBE and blood film**, looking for marrow suppression or a macrocytic anaemia. Total and active B12 (holotranscobalamin) may be low or undetectable; **methylmalonic acid is usually raised.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Do not withhold vitamin B12 and methionine because levels are normal** in a patient with clinical signs and a history of nitrous oxide misuse — measured B12 does not reflect functional B12.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **MRI brain and/or spine may show demyelination; nerve conduction studies may show impaired transmission.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Stop nitrous oxide; treatment rests on IM vitamin B12 plus oral methionine.** ☎️ **Toxicology advice: Victorian Poisons Information Centre, 13 11 26.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Admit if unable to walk independently or with haematological or psychiatric sequelae.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Vitamin B12 1 mg IM daily for 2 weeks, then weekly for 4 weeks, then monthly until maximal recovery.** Higher weekly IM doses speed resolution and may improve recovery.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Consult haematology if there is marrow suppression**; consider other nutritional deficiencies from poor intake.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Any child or adolescent with intentional overdose: consult the paediatric team and consider admission.**
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Discharge when:** walking safely and independently · haematological dysfunction improving (if present) · safe from a mental health perspective with drug and alcohol referrals made · educated about the dangers of nitrous oxide misuse.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Before discharge, assess adolescents with deliberate ingestion for risk of further ingestion or self-harm**, and screen for other drug and alcohol use.
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Nitrous Oxide Misuse' (Last updated February 2021), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Nitrous_Oxide_Misuse/, retrieved 2026-09-23
